info.title: AuthHub Public API
info.description: Versioned public contract for agency developers. Additive-only change within a version; breaking change ships as a new version.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Scoped agency API key as `Bearer <secret>`. The required scope is listed per operation; failures name the missing scope.

get.summary: Return the calling key agency, scopes, tier, and limit hints. No scope required.
